source: explicit per-release evidence index for the Codex native runtime qualification workflow

rules.version_key: exact codex-cli release string; never a range, wildcard, or semver comparison
rules.bundle_selection: look up the exact version; never pick 'latest' lexically or semantically
rules.qualified: only a qualified bundle corresponds to an entry in CODEX_RUNTIME_VERIFIED_VERSIONS
rules.candidates: captured-but-unqualified releases live under candidates/ and are never interpreted as supported
